notes: Implemented Phase 2 (Panel Editing & Crop Controls) of the CollageMaker web port plan: 6 new files (CropInfo model, CropManager, SaliencyFallback, GestureHandler, CropInteraction, UndoManager) and 12 modified files. Features: panel selection via canvas hit testing (rect + polygon even-odd), crop preview canvas with drag/resize, undo/redo with 60-level command stack, keyboard shortcuts (Cmd+Z, Cmd+Shift+Z, Escape). Post-implementation world-review identified and fixed 8 issues: (1) handle size mismatch 8px visual vs 12px hit-test aligned, (2) redo key check made case-insensitive, (3) crop placeholder added when no panel selected, (4) hover highlight on panels with blue border, (5) UndoManager redo() history corruption fixed by reusing original command objects, (6) crop resize mirroring bug fixed by clamping cursor before computing dimensions, (7) live crop preview during drag already working confirmed, (8) undo batch API usage reviewed and confirmed correct. Automated verification: zero console errors, Vue app mounts, all UI elements present.
